title.romaji: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyou Binbou
title.native: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏

synonyms: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyou Binbou: Party Jijou de Fuyo Jutsushi wo Yatteita Kenshi, Bannou e to Itaru
勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏　～パーティ事情で付与術士をやっていた剣士、万能へと至る～
เก่งรอบด้านแต่ไร้ทีเด็ด เลยถูกเฉดหัวจากปาร์ตี้ผู้กล้า
Si Serbabisa Terbuang Ini Akan Bangkit Jua!
description:
Betrayed by his childhood friend and cast out of the Hero Party, Orhun Dura—once their loyal Enchanter—is branded by his former comrades as “a jack-of-all-trades but a master of none.” Alone, he sets out to forge a new path as a solo adventurer. His journey sparks explosive battles, deadly rivals, and unexpected allies—and he’ll rise to shatter every expectation. The ultimate solo comeback begins!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description: She is the leader of the S-rank party that reigns supreme within the major clan, "Night Sky Silver Rabbits," and is the continent's greatest "Enchanter." She has had a high opinion of [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) since his days in the "Hero Party," even entrusting him with accompanying her on "Training Expeditions," a training ground for new recruits. She dotes on her younger sister, [Sophia](https://anilist.co/character/356658/Sophia-Clodel), with all her heart.

He is an explorer who defeats the magical beasts that lurk in the labyrinth, and was a member of the "Hero Party" that reached the unprecedented 94th floor of the labyrinth, where no one has yet reached the lowest 100th floor. For the sake of his companions, he converted from a "Swordsman" to an "Enchanter" and developed his own unique form of magic. He supported them in many ways, but one day he was suddenly ridiculed as a "Jack of all trades, master of none" and expelled from the party. Since then, he has made a fresh start, aiming to become the strongest explorer, someone who can be called a "Jack of all trades."

name.native: ソフィア・クローデル

node.description: A new magician in the major clan "Night Sky Silver Rabbits," and [Selma's](https://anilist.co/character/356659/Selma-Clodel) younger sister. She was attacked by a magical beast while secretly infiltrating a labyrinth without the clan's knowledge, but was saved by [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura). She has a gentle personality, but her abilities are genuine, and she is a member of the promising new party "Squad 10." She serves as a rearguard attacker.

name.native: キャロライン・イングロット

node.description: A member of the promising newcomer party "Squad 10" belonging to "The Silver Rabbit of the Night Sky," she aims to become an evasive "Defender." For some reason, she has a tendency to charge headfirst into magical beasts, causing constant concern for those around her.

name.native: ルーナ・フロックハート

node.description: A member of the "Hero Party" Golden Dawn, she holds the position of Healer. She values ​​[Orhun's](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) abilities more than anyone else, and went to personally ask him to return to their party. Orhun also has a deep trust in her.

A member of the S-rank party "First Unit" belonging to the Night Sky Silver Rabbits, she is a Magician. She is extremely fast at constructing spells and can cast special-grade magic spells one after another. Contrary to her young appearance, she is the oldest member of the party and is caring and considerate.

name.native: シオン・ナスタチウム

node.description: A mysterious girl who belongs to the criminal organization "Amunzers," which attacks advanced explorers without question.

name.native: ルクレーシャ・オーティス

node.description: A member of the S-rank party "First Unit" belonging to the Night Sky Silver Rabbits, she is a Healer. She can track a caster's location by following traces of magical energy. She is the mood maker of the party.

name.native: フィリー・カーペンター

node.description: She is a new member of the Hero's Party, replacing [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura), who left the group. She dives deep into the depths to check the coordination, but is overwhelmed by the number of orders...

name.native: ローガン・ヘイワード

node.description: He is the leader of the promising newcomer party "Squad 10" belonging to "The Silver Rabbits of the Night Sky." He is an excellent "Enchanter," and even [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) acknowledges his high level of ability. He is fearless and always has a desire to improve himself.

She is a member of the "Hero Party" Golden Dawn, and her position is Magician. She looks down on everyone and often behaves in a condescending manner. When they kicked [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) out of the party, she mocked him, calling him a "jack of all trades, master of none."

name.native: ウィルクス・セヴァリー

node.description: He is a member of the S-rank party "First Unit" belonging to the Night Sky Silver Rabbits and plays the position of "Defender." He feels guilty after his former member Albert lost his life because of him. He is friendly, easy to talk to, and a reliable presence.

name.native: オリヴァー・カーディフ

node.description: He is the leader of the "Hero Party" "Golden Dawn" and plays the role of "Attacker." He has the "Supernatural Power" of "Magic Convergence," which allows him to gather magical power in his sword and generate extraordinary destructive power. He is also the one who kicked his childhood friend [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura) out of the party.

name.native: デリック・モーズレイ

node.description: A member of the "Hero Party" Golden Dawn. His position is Defender, and he uses a large shield to deflect attacks from magical beasts. He is hot-blooded, has a short-sighted way of thinking, and looks down on [Orhun](https://anilist.co/character/356657/Orhun-Dura).
